item.title: Iran live updates: Iran launches 'most strikes yet'
item.summary: President Donald Trump announced "major combat operations" against Iran on Feb. 28.

item.title: Inflation report to be released as Iran war sends gas prices surging
item.summary: Overall prices cooled in recent months but remain above the Fed's target.

item.title: Germany, Austria to release oil from reserves in response to 400M barrel request
item.summary: Germany and Austria say they are releasing parts of their oil reserves following an International Energy Agency request for its members to release 400 million barrels to help temper energy price spikes due to the Iran war

item.title: WATCH: War will end with Iran's 'unconditional surrender,' WH press secretary Leavitt says
item.summary: Leavitt said a timeline for the end of the military operation in Iran would be left up to President Trump and would only happen when there is an "unconditional surrender" of the Iranian regime.

item.title: WATCH: Pentagon releases new video as U.S. airstrikes intensify in Iran
item.summary: The Pentagon released new video Tuesday showing the U.S. unleashing massive air attacks on Iranian targets.

item.title: WATCH: Crews battle intense barge fire in Delaware
item.summary: A massive fire erupted on an unmanned barge in New Castle, Delaware. Flames scorched through mounds of scrap metal as fire crew battled the flames for hours.

item.title: WATCH: Trump 'would not be happy' if Russia was sharing intelligence with Iran
item.summary: WH press sec. Karoline Leavitt told ABC News' Karen Travers neither Pres. Trump nor U.S. special envoy Steve Witkoff "would be happy" if it turns out Russia has been sharing intelligence with Iran.

item.title: LIVE: ABC News Live
item.summary: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: WATCH: Alabama father and son tell David Muir about redeeming decades-long birthday promise
item.summary: Jimmy Rush and his 99-year-old dad are the first customers of Wintzell's Oyster House in Alabama to redeem the restaurant's reward of free oysters to any 80-year-old accompanied by their father.

item.title: WATCH: WNBA season up in the air as CBA negotiations deadline closes in
item.summary: ESPN's Alexa Philippou gives an update on negotiations as the deadline for talks between the WNBA and the player's association nears.
